purpose: Season-specific complete-block roles for the from-scratch E02 design
leakage_rule: Never split rows from the same treatment across calibration and validation

factor_mapping_source.25SP: XXQL2501.TMX MI/MF table plus frozen treatment_metadata
factor_mapping_source.26SP: XXQL2601.TMX MI/MF table plus frozen treatment_metadata
factor_mapping_source.25FA: rebuilt 25FA bundle TMX/TMT/FileA, frozen validation metadata only

notes: This file is a design record only; it must not be passed to the current builder as a validation_split_id.
The 25FA validation block is locked and cannot trigger bounds, weights, candidate selection, or seasonal offsets.
If rebuilt bundle metadata disagrees with these roles, stop and revise this file before calibration.
